title: 第0025章星火燎原第0026章城外野火
content_zh:
第0025章星火燎原镇灶里的余烬明明灭灭，映得“刀鱼小灶”的地面像片波光粼粼的湖。巴刀鱼坐在灶膛前，手里攥着块焦炭——是今天从城西菜市场、城南贫民窟、城东养老院、城北孤儿院带回来的。焦炭里的火星还没灭透，一粒一粒，像群睡着的萤火虫。
酸菜汤躺在长椅上，脚翘在灶台上，手里拿着个冷馒头，啃得咔嚓响。“主厨，”她含糊不清地说，“明天去哪儿？”
巴刀鱼没说话，把焦炭放在灶台上。四块焦炭排成一排，火星连成片，像条发光的线。他想起今天在孤儿院，孩子们围在灶台边，眼睛亮得像星星；想起养老院的老人，给老伴的遗像前摆上一碗萝卜汤，嘴里念叨“今天熬得比昨天好”；想起贫民窟的女人，把最后一口粥喂给丈夫，笑着说“明天我去捡更好的菜”；想起菜市场的摊主，把煮烂的“怨气菇”倒进垃圾桶，说“以后只卖干净的菜”。
“哪儿有黑窟窿，咱们就去哪儿。”他说。
酸菜汤把冷馒头塞进嘴里，坐起来：“那明天去城中湖？娃娃鱼说湖底有股黑气，把星火啃了个洞。”
巴刀鱼点头，看向后院。娃娃鱼正蹲在井台边，指尖蘸着井水画星图。井水映着她的脸，苍白得像张纸，可眼睛却亮得吓人。井水里的星图上，城中湖的位置有团墨汁似的黑影，正慢慢往星火里渗。
“湖底有‘怨气菇’，”娃娃鱼头也不抬，“比菜市场的更毒。吃了的人会发疯，跳湖自杀。”
酸菜汤“呸”了声：“这群狗娘养的，又来这套！”
巴刀鱼盯着井水里的黑影，想起今天在孤儿院，横肉男人喝下粥后哭着说“我娘以前也给我熬这种粥”。他知道，这次不一样了。以前是把光捅进黑窟窿，这次得把光沉到湖底。
“明天早上去城中湖，”他说，“得把‘怨气菇’捞上来。”
酸菜汤点头，躺回长椅：“主厨，我明天带铁铲。”
娃娃鱼画完星图，抬头看着天空。夜空里，星星一颗一颗亮起来，像盏盏小灯。她轻声说：“星轨在变。灶底的光，已经成了火种。只要有人愿意点，就能燎原。”
巴刀鱼看着灶台上的焦炭，火星慢慢灭了，可心里的火却烧得更旺。他想起父亲说过的话：“灶底的光，不在多旺，不在多亮。在，有人愿意为你点。”他轻声说：“是啊，只要有人愿意点，火就不会灭。”
**黎明·城中湖**
天刚蒙蒙亮，三人已站在城中湖边。湖水黑得像墨汁，湖面上飘着层雾，看不见对岸。湖边的长椅上，坐着几个发呆的人，眼神发直。巴刀鱼走到湖边，蹲下身，伸手摸了摸湖水。湖水冰凉，带着股甜腥味，像摸了块烂肉。
“怨气，”娃娃鱼蹲在他旁边，指尖蘸着井水画星图，“湖底的‘怨气菇’把湖水染黑了。吃了湖水的人会发疯，跳湖自杀。”
酸菜汤扛着铁铲，骂了句：“真他娘的恶心！”
巴刀鱼站起来，看着湖面。湖面上飘着些东西：有撕碎的纸钱，有带血的指甲，还有些说不清道明的碎渣。他想起今天在菜市场，锅里的“怨气菇”煮出的黑水，也是这样。“得把湖水煮开，”他说，“把毒煮出来。”
酸菜汤愣了下：“煮开？这湖这么大，怎么煮？”
“用灶底的光，”巴刀鱼从围裙口袋里掏出块焦炭，“把火种扔进湖里。”

娃娃鱼点头，蘸着井水在焦炭上画了个符。符是透明的，可画完后，焦炭上却泛起层金光，像抹了层蜂蜜。
巴刀鱼把焦炭扔进湖里。焦炭一进水，湖水立刻沸腾起来，冒出黑泡，像口煮沸的墨汁。他拿起长勺，慢慢搅。搅着搅着，湖水里的黑泡里浮出些东西：有撕碎的纸钱，有带血的指甲，还有些说不清道明的碎渣。酸菜汤捂着鼻子，骂了句：“真他娘的恶心！”
“怨气，”娃娃鱼轻声说，“是吃湖水的人心里的怨气，被‘怨气菇’吸走了。”
巴刀鱼搅得更慢了。他想起在废工厂里，那些少年用废铁拼灶时说的话：“只要能烧饭，就不是垃圾。”想起监狱里的老陈，切菜时说的“我恨自己”；想起精神病院的小雨，喝下土豆汤后说的“咸了”；想起战场废墟里的伤兵，喝下白粥后哭着说的“那是我家”。原来灶底的光，从来不是什么玄乎的东西，而是这些——是少年的倔强，是囚犯的忏悔，是病人的苏醒，是伤兵的怀念。
湖水渐渐变清，那些碎渣沉到湖底，像层淤泥。巴刀鱼舀起一勺水，递给旁边一个发呆的人：“喝一口。”
那人抬头，眼神还是发直，可还是接过勺子，喝了口。喝完后，他愣了下，突然捂住脸，哭出声来：“我想起来了……我老婆昨天走了……我昨天喝了湖水，忘了给她烧饭……”
巴刀鱼又舀了一勺，递给另一个人。那人喝完，也哭了：“我想起来了……我昨天骂了我儿子，说他没用……可他昨天还给我买了糖葫芦……”
湖水一勺勺递出去，湖边哭声一片。那些被“怨气菇”吃掉的记忆，全回来了。巴刀鱼看着他们，心里那团火烧得更旺了——原来灶底的光，不仅能暖胃，还能醒心。
突然，湖面上传来阵骚动。几个穿黑袍的人划着船过来，手里拿着刀，脸上蒙着黑布。“谁让你们动这湖水的？”为首的人吼着，刀尖指向巴刀鱼，“这些是‘食魇’大人的贡品！”
巴刀鱼放下长勺，走到湖边。他盯着那些黑袍人，想起井水里的黑影。“你们是食魇教的人？”他问。
“知道还问？”黑袍人挥了挥刀，“赶紧滚，不然连你们一起砍！”
content_en:
Chapter 0025: A Spark Starts a Prairie Fire The embers in the stove were extinguished, making the ground of the "Knife Fish Stove" look like a sparkling lake. Basio is sitting in front of the stove, holding a piece of coke in his hand - he brought it back today from the vegetable market in the west of the city, the slums in the south of the city, the nursing home in the east of the city, and the orphanage in the north of the city. The sparks in the coke have not yet been extinguished, one by one, like a group of sleeping fireflies.
Pickled cabbage soup was lying on the bench, with his feet raised on the stove, holding a cold steamed bun in his hand, making a clicking sound. "Chef," she said vaguely, "where are you going tomorrow?"
The fish didn't say anything and put the coke on the stove. Four pieces of coke are lined up in a row, and the sparks are connected into a sheet, like a glowing line. He thought of the children gathered around the stove in the orphanage today, their eyes as bright as stars; he thought of the old man in the nursing home who put a bowl of carrot soup in front of his wife's portrait and said, "Today is better than yesterday"; he thought of the woman in the slum, feeding the last mouthful of porridge to her husband and saying with a smile, "I will pick better vegetables tomorrow"; he thought of the stall owner in the vegetable market, pouring the boiled "grievance mushrooms" into the trash can and saying, "I will only sell clean vegetables from now on."
"Wherever there is a dark hole, we will go there," he said.
Pickled cabbage soup stuffed the cold steamed buns into his mouth and sat up: "How about going to Chengzhong Lake tomorrow? Salamander said there was a black gas at the bottom of the lake and gnawed a hole in Xinghuo."
The bass fish nodded and looked toward the backyard. The giant salamander is squatting beside the well platform, dipping his fingertips in the well water to draw a star map. Her face reflected in the well water was as pale as a piece of paper, but her eyes were frighteningly bright. On the star map in the well water, there is a black shadow like ink at the location of the lake in the city, which is slowly seeping into the star fire.
"There is a 'Grudge Mushroom' at the bottom of the lake," said the giant salamander without raising its head. "It is more poisonous than the ones in the wet market. People who eat it will go crazy and commit suicide by jumping into the lake."
Pickled cabbage soup said "poof": "These sons of bitches are doing this again!"
Basioyu stared at the black shadow in the well water, and remembered that in the orphanage today, the Hengrou man cried after drinking the porridge and said, "My mother used to cook this kind of porridge for me." He knew that this time was different. In the past, I had to shine the light into the dark hole, but this time I had to sink the light to the bottom of the lake.
"Go to Chengzhong Lake tomorrow morning," he said, "and have to fish out the 'Grudge Mushroom'."
Pickled cabbage soup nodded and lay back on the bench: "Chef, I will bring a shovel tomorrow."
After the baby fish finished drawing the star map, he looked up at the sky. In the night sky, the stars lit up one by one, like small lights. She whispered: "The star trails are changing. The light on the bottom of the stove has become a fire. As long as someone is willing to light it, it can start a prairie fire."
Ba Yu looked at the charcoal on the stove. The sparks were slowly extinguished, but the fire in his heart burned even brighter. He remembered what his father had said: "The light at the bottom of the stove does not matter how bright it is. It does not matter whether someone is willing to light it for you." He said softly: "Yes, as long as someone is willing to light it, the fire will not go out."
**Dawn·City Lake**
At dawn, the three of them were already standing by the lake in the city. The water of the lake was as black as ink, and there was a layer of fog floating on the surface of the lake, making it impossible to see the other side. On the benches by the lake, there were a few people sitting in a daze, their eyes straight. The bass fish walked to the edge of the lake, squatted down, and reached out to touch the lake water. The lake water was cold and had a sweet smell, like touching a piece of rotten meat.
"Grudge," the giant salamander squatted next to him, dipping his fingertips in the well water to draw a star map. "The 'grievance mushroom' at the bottom of the lake dyes the lake water black. People who eat the lake water will go crazy and commit suicide by jumping into the lake."
Pickled cabbage soup carried the shovel and cursed: "It's so damn disgusting!"
The bass fish stood up and looked at the lake. There were some things floating on the lake: torn paper money, bloody nails, and some unexplainable debris. He thought of the black water produced by the "grievance mushroom" in the pot at the vegetable market today, and it was the same. "You have to boil the lake water," he said, "to boil out the poison."
Pickled cabbage soup was stunned for a moment: "Boil it? The lake is so big, how can you cook it?"
"Use the light from the bottom of the stove," Basiyu took out a piece of coke from his apron pocket, "throw the kindlingEnter the lake. "
The giant salamander nodded, dipped in well water and drew a talisman on the coke. The talisman is transparent, but after the painting is completed, a layer of golden light appears on the coke, like a layer of honey.
The bass throws the coke into the lake. As soon as the coke enters the water, the lake water immediately boils and black bubbles appear, like boiling ink. He picked up the ladle and stirred slowly. Stirring and stirring, something emerged from the black bubbles in the lake: torn paper money, bloody nails, and some unexplainable debris. Pickled cabbage soup covered his nose and cursed: "It's so damn disgusting! "
"Resentment," Baby Fish said softly, "is the resentment in the hearts of people who eat lake water, and it is sucked away by the 'Resentment Mushroom'. "
The bass stirred even more slowly. He recalled what the teenagers said when they were building a stove with scrap metal in the abandoned factory: “As long as it can cook, it’s not garbage. "I think of Lao Chen in prison, who said "I hate myself" while chopping vegetables; I think of the light rain in the mental hospital, and said "it's salty" after drinking potato soup; I think of the wounded soldiers in the ruins of the battlefield, and cried and said "that's my home" after drinking white porridge. It turns out that the light under the stove has never been a mysterious thing, but these - it is the stubbornness of the young man, the confession of the prisoner, the awakening of the patient, and the memory of the wounded soldier.
The lake water gradually became clearer, and the debris sank to the bottom of the lake, like a layer of silt. The fish scooped up a spoonful of water and handed it to a dazed man next to him: "Take a sip. "
The man raised his head, his eyes still straight, but he still took the spoon and took a sip. After finishing the drink, he froze for a moment, suddenly covered his face and cried out: "I remembered... my wife left yesterday... I drank the lake water yesterday and forgot to cook for her..."
The fish took another spoonful and handed it to the other person. After the man finished drinking, he also cried: "I remember...I scolded my son yesterday and said he was useless...but he bought me candied haws yesterday..."
The lake water was handed out in spoonfuls, and there was a lot of crying around the lake. All those memories of being eaten by the "Grudge Mushroom" came back. As Basio looked at them, the fire in his heart burned even brighter - it turned out that the light from the bottom of the stove could not only warm the stomach, but also wake up the mind.
Suddenly, there was a commotion on the lake. Several men in black robes rowed over with knives in their hands and their faces covered with black cloths. "Who asked you to touch this lake? "The leader roared, pointing the tip of the knife at the bat fish, "These are the tributes of Master Nightmare Eater! "
The bass fish put down the ladle and walked to the lake. He stared at the men in black robes and thought of the dark shadows in the well water. "Are you from the Nightmare Eater Cult? he asked.
"You know and you still ask? "The man in black robe waved his knife, "Get out of here quickly, or I'll kill you too! "
